memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Whoever sheds human blood, by humans shall their blood be shed; for in the image of God has God made mankind." - Gen 9:6 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
After the flood, God establishes a solemn principle to restrain the violence that had filled the earth: human life is sacred, and to murder a person is a grave offence against God Himself. And notice the reason He gives - "for in the image of God has God made mankind." Every human being bears God's image, so an attack on a person is an attack on the God whose likeness they carry.

This is one of the most important truths in all of Scripture for how we value people. Human worth is not based on usefulness, ability, achievement, or status. It rests on this: every single person is made in the image of God. That is why murder is so serious, and why every human life - from the tiniest unborn child to the frailest elderly person - carries immense dignity and worth.

In a world that so often measures people by what they can do or produce, this truth stands firm. The image of God is stamped on every person you will ever meet, including the ones the world overlooks or discards.

This shapes how we treat others every day. James warns against cursing people "who have been made in God's likeness" (Jas 3:9). If God so values human life, we must too - in our words, our attitudes, and our actions. And the God who made us in His image sent His Son to restore that image in us, dying for people He counts precious. See every person today through God's eyes: an image-bearer of infinite worth.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you truly see every person as made in God's image?
- How would your words and actions change if you saw people this way?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, help me see the sacred worth of every person, made in Your image. Guard my heart from contempt, and help me honour Your likeness in everyone I meet, as You have honoured it in me through Christ.
